23template <typename T>
24inline T lerp_bipolar(const T in, const T out_lo, const T out_hi) {
25 return (in + static_cast<T>(1.0)) / static_cast<T>(2.0) * (out_hi - out_lo) +
26 out_lo;
27}

39template <typename T>
40inline T lerp_unipolar(const T in, const T out_lo, const T out_hi) {
41 return in * (out_hi - out_lo) + out_lo;
42}

56template <typename T>
57inline T lerp(const T val, const T in_lo, const T in_hi, const T out_lo,
58 const T out_hi) {
59 const T in_norm = (val - in_lo) / (in_hi - in_lo);
60 return lerp_unipolar<T>(in_norm, out_lo, out_hi);
61}

72template <typename T>
73inline T normalize_unipolar(const T in, const T in_lo, const T in_hi) {
74 return lerp(in, in_lo, in_hi, static_cast<T>(0.0), static_cast<T>(1.0));
75}
